summary: Repoint T084 web-provenance current-evidence reference from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; preserve T109 as historical read-only predecessor pending SUPERSEDE; add T112 to dependencies; keep all Must-not clauses intact; extend T084 depends_on in todo/config.yaml accordingly. No business code, no workflow state, no Intent/Spec changes.
rationale: T112 has been DELIVERED and approved (replaces: [T109]) and is the current registry-bound product-run evidence source per A0026. T084 is one of the still-PLANNED direct T109 consumers named in T112's runtime-cutover clause, so the T084 contract must record T112 as the current evidence source rather than T109. T109 is retained in Dependencies and References as a historical read-only predecessor until the annotation-only SUPERSEDE amendment retires it. The corresponding depends_on extension in todo/config.yaml is required for the controller's drift check; without it the contract and config would disagree on T084's dependency surface.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable: PROJECT_GOALS.md is unchanged. The amendment operates only on a downstream P08 task contract and its config dependency list. No product-intent question is reopened by repointing which T1xx sibling supplies T084's current evidence.
impact_assessment.specification: Not applicable: WEB_CONSOLE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2, and the rest of docs/spec/ are unchanged. The current-evidence source naming in T084 is a contract-level binding, not a Spec statement. The Spec-level cutover from T109 to T112 was already documented in the T112 contract and recorded by spec_revision v1-2026-09-23-a0026-run-evidence-cutover.
impact_assessment.contracts: Applicable: T084.md is the only contract edited. Dependencies now lists T025, T072, T080, T109, T112. Console-scope narrative, Deliverables, Acceptance, and References were rewritten to treat T112 as the current registry-bound manifest and paired simulation-evidence source; T109 is preserved as historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment. The pre-T109 T105/T063 historical reference, the Acceptance enumeration of distinguishable provenance renderings, and the fail-closed mismatch check were updated only to add T112 as the current authority and to make T109's historical status explicit. The Must-not clause that bans presenting a pre-T109 T105/T063 artifact as current provenance is preserved unchanged. No other task contract is touched.
impact_assessment.dependencies: Applicable: todo/config.yaml under tasks.T084, depends_on extended from [T025, T072, T080, T109] to [T025, T072, T080, T109, T112]. T112 is DELIVERED with replaces=[T109], so the dependency remains satisfiable. T109 stays in the list as a historical predecessor binding. No other task's record was touched. active_task, active_phase, workflow_state, intent_revision, spec_revision, and agent_runtime are unchanged.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable: this amendment makes no business-code change. No reader, writer, schema, validator, formatter, type checker, or test is created, modified, or removed. The contract+config edit is the only surface changed. T084 remains OPEN with attempt=0 and no candidate/approved commit; no implementation gate is opened or closed.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable: no persisted artifact is created, modified, migrated, or reinterpreted. T084 is a read-only Web shell that surfaces evidence recorded by T112's writer (and T109's historical artifacts via the legacy reader path). The amendment changes the contract text that names which writer is the current authority; it does not change the data on disk or in any registered object.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable: no runtime surface is touched. The amendable runtime-cutover clause in T112 already lists T084 as one of the PLANNED consumers that must be repointed before the T109→T112 cutover is enabled; this amendment does not enable that cutover (T084 remains PLANNED). Background operation, browser restart semantics, and any deployment or signer concerns are out of scope.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable: T084's read-only Web shell contract is unchanged in capability. No secret handling, authentication, signing, signer memory, keystore, or wallet-control surface is altered. The amendment only swaps which task's evidence the contract calls current, with T109 retained read-only.
impact_assessment.verification: Applicable: the controller's drift check at finish-amendment verifies that T084.md and todo/config.yaml agree on the depends_on set. This amendment edits both surfaces atomically so the drift check passes. No test was added or relaxed; the existing T084 contract acceptance clauses (distinguishable provenance rendering, fail-closed mismatch, no duplicate projection, no secret in rendered provenance) remain the binding verification gate for the task when it eventually opens for implementation.
